# SheepIt Renderfarm

> > Free distributed renderfarm for Blender projects using collaborative computing power with support for Cycles, Eevee, and Workbench render engines.

SheepIt Renderfarm is a community-driven, free rendering service where users contribute their idle computing resources to help others render Blender projects. The platform operates on a credit-based system where rendering for others earns points to render your own projects.

## Key Topics

- Blender
- Cycles render engine
- Eevee render engine
- Workbench render engine
- Distributed rendering
- Collaborative rendering
- Free rendering service
- GPU rendering
- Cloud rendering
- Render credits system
- Community renderfarm
- Blender Foundation
- Team rankings
- Render jobs

## Getting Started

- [SheepIt Homepage](https://www.sheepit-renderfarm.com/): Main homepage for SheepIt distributed Blender renderfarm with Cycles/Eevee support
- [SheepIt Landing Page](https://www.sheepit-renderfarm.com/index.php/home): Introduction to SheepIt free collaborative rendering service and how to get started

## Rendering & Client Access

- [Client Portal](https://client.sheepit-renderfarm.com/): Access your rendering jobs, manage projects, and monitor render progress

## API Reference

- [API Endpoint](https://api.sheepit-renderfarm.com/): Programmatic access to SheepIt renderfarm for automation and integration

## Optional

- [Sandbox Environment](http://sandbox.sheepit-renderfarm.com/): Testing environment for SheepIt renderfarm development and experimentation
- [Team Rankings (Sandbox)](https://sandbox.sheepit-renderfarm.com/team): Team leaderboard and rankings in the SheepIt sandbox testing environment
